description: Count and reason, one switcher, one command, prototype branch, feedback record
prompt: Prototype what the onboarding flow should look like for our note-taking app.
expectations: States the sample count (1 to 3) and the reason for it
Puts the samples behind one switcher (for example ?variant=) rather than separate apps
Gives a single command or URL that runs the prototype
Keeps the work on a prototype/<name> branch and does not merge it to the base branch
After the trial, records feedback under worked / did not / surprised me, and names okay-to-spec as the consumer
Does not write the spec before the trial
